title: Life of a Collection Booking on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
A collection booking stays usable for the schedule's label validity days, counted in calendar days from the day it is issued, so that the last day it may be used is that many days after the day of issue. The days a booking stays open are never fewer than the floor this desk keeps for a booking of any kind, which is 2 days.

The carrier recorded on the booking is the one that is to move the item: a return the schedule charges a freight collection fee for is moved by regional freight, a collection from the customer's address on a schedule that charges no freight collection fee is moved by the retailer's own van, an item travelling back through the parcel network on a label is moved by national parcel, and an item the customer brings to a store counter is recorded as delivered by the customer.

## The quantity, put as a definition

The days a Northbeam Returns and Restocking booking is held open are the schedule's label validity days. The floor of 2 days is applied to the days so counted: the days held open are that figure where the days counted come to 2 or more, and 2 days where they come to fewer.

| What is read | Where it is read from |
| --- | --- |
| the schedule's label validity days | the figure published against the return schedule the line falls under |
| the day of issue | the day the booking is made, which is day zero of the count |
| the floor | 2 days, the floor this desk keeps for a booking of any kind |

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

*A return on a schedule whose published label validity days are 10, the booking made today.* The days the booking is held open are 10, that figure being 2 or more, and the last day it may be used is the tenth day after today.

*A return on a schedule whose published label validity days are 1.* The days counted come to 1, which is fewer than 2, so the booking is held open for 2 days.

*A return on a schedule whose published label validity days are 0.* The days counted come to 0, so the booking is held open for 2 days.

## The carrier, put as a table

| The journey back | The carrier recorded |
| --- | --- |
| a return on a schedule that charges a freight collection fee | regional freight |
| a collection from the customer's address on a schedule that charges no freight collection fee | the retailer's own van |
| the item travels back through the parcel network on a label | national parcel |
| the customer brings the item to a store counter | delivered by the customer |
